titulo: The red dot is a tiny alarm clock.
caption:
First thing after waking up: who goes first, you or the red dot?
When my eyes open: feet on the floor. The phone gets the second minute.
If standing up makes you dizzy, go slowly: lying, then sitting, then standing.
Send it to the one who wakes up before the alarm.
The tool is on the page: link in bio.
by NMR
#firstthingafterwakingup #morningwithoutphone #sleepinertia #naos
